name: YMCA Summer Camp (Smithfield YMCA)
description_short: Smithfield YMCA's summer day camp in Greenville, RI for children entering kindergarten through 6th grade, chosen week by week (up to 9 weeks). Days mix outdoor play, sports, arts, STEM, optional daily swimming and field trips; extended hours run 7am to 6pm.
